svg.title: Live from the Embankment: London skyline of GitHub contributions for mdtarek-islam
svg.desc: Night skyline of London over the Thames Embankment for mdtarek-islam. Silhouettes of the London Eye, St Paul's Cathedral, the Gherkin, Tower Bridge and the Shard stand behind 52 week buildings. No contribution data yet: every building sits at the base height with dark windows. Contribution data loads on the first scheduled run.
svg.text: One building per week, one window per day
Contribution data loads on the first scheduled run
